commands.cmd: p=$(command -v qdrant) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" qdrant

A="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/downloads/qdrant-1.19.1/qdrant-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"; e=$(grep 'qdrant/qdrant / v1.19.1' recipes/README.md | grep -o '[0-9a-f]\{64\}'); a=$(sha256sum < "$A" | cut -c1-64); m=$(tar -xzOf "$A" qdrant | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); i=$(sha256sum < "$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/qdrant-1.19.1/qdrant" | cut -c1-64); echo "recipes/README.md v1.19.1 archive sha256 $(echo $e | cut -c1-16)... | retained archive $(echo $a | cut -c1-16)..."; echo "archive member qdrant $(echo $m | cut -c1-16)... | installed $(echo $i | cut -c1-16)..."; test -n "$e" && test "$a" = "$e" && test "$m" = "$i" && echo "retained archive matches the recorded release hash; installed binary equals its member"
